sole_research_target_acknowledgement: My sole research target is the full quadratic-form bounded-density statement for arbitrary independent real inputs with marginal densities bounded by one and arbitrary real symmetric A having at least three eigenvalues of absolute value at least one; no other research target is active for this slot.

latest_result.scope: If disjoint physical k-by-k cross block A[I,J] is invertible with k>=3, arbitrary principal-block curvature and outside couplings are allowed and Q has a bounded continuous density with norm at most k/(k-2)*|det A[I,J]|^(-1/k). A rank-three full cross map admits an all-minors cross-volume version using the source-backed bounded-density projection theorem.

first_essential_unresolved_implication: Derive a universal spectral-to-cross-volume/local-structure dichotomy from the hypothesis of at least three eigenvalues of absolute value at least one: either some physical triple I has sqrt(det(A[I,I^c]A[I,I^c]^T)) bounded below universally, or A lies quantitatively in an already controlled localized/separable branch.
next_concrete_step: Exploit A[I,I^c]A[I,I^c]^T=(A^2)[I,I]-A[I,I]^2 together with exterior-power mass and the current localized/diffuse theorems to prove or refute that dichotomy without selecting one tiny coordinate minor.
